beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus told one more short story about the kingdom of heaven, and this time he set it out on the water.

timing.text: Jesus told one more short story about the kingdom of heaven, and this time he set it out on the water.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

timing.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Picture fishermen throwing a great wide net off the side of the boat, letting it sink down and drag through the whole sea.

timing.text: Picture fishermen throwing a great wide net off the side of the boat, letting it sink down and drag through the whole sea.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And here is the first beautiful thing. That net does not pick and choose. It sweeps up every kind of fish there is: big ones, small ones, common ones, strange ones, everything the sea has in it, gathered in together.

timing.text: And here is the first beautiful thing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The net is not fussy about who gets caught up in it. The gathering is wide open. Nobody swimming in that sea is too ordinary, or too far gone, to be swept up into it.

timing.text: The net is not fussy about who gets caught up in it.
The gathering is wide open.
Nobody swimming in that sea is too ordinary, or too far gone, to be swept up into it.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

timing.text: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When the net is full, the fishermen drag the whole heavy thing up onto the shore, and they sit down beside it. And only then, once everyone is already gathered in, does any sorting begin.

timing.text: When the net is full, the fishermen drag the whole heavy thing up onto the shore, and they sit down beside it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They gather the good fish carefully into baskets, keeping them, valuing them, not losing a single one.

timing.text: They gather the good fish carefully into baskets, keeping them, valuing them, not losing a single one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And the ones that cannot be kept, they set aside. Jesus said that is a picture of how things finally end.

timing.text: And the ones that cannot be kept, they set aside.
Jesus said that is a picture of how things finally end.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just

timing.text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

timing.text: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: There is a real end, and a real sorting. But notice whose job it is. The angels do it. God does it. At the very end. It was never handed to us to do.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So here is what the little story leaves you with. You do not have to spend your life deciding who belongs and who does not. That is not your net, and it is not your sorting.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Your part is simply this: the net was cast for the whole sea, and it was cast for you. The gathering came first. Grace reached out wide enough to catch you up in it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is how good he is. He threw the net over the whole ocean of us, of every kind, so that not one soul who wanted to be found would be missed.

card.text: The net was cast wide enough to gather you in. Will you let yourself be caught up in his grace?
